name: geosilo
description: Compact geometry storage for DuckDB. A first-class GEOSILO column type that delta-encodes coordinates as scaled integers and pairs with ZSTD for ~21% smaller geometry storage than DuckDB's GEOMETRY (and ~70% smaller raw blobs against WKB). Native ST_* overloads for bounding-box, area, length, and introspection skip the WKB decode entirely.

cta.title: Compact geometry, native fast paths
cta.description: Install GeoSilo for smaller-on-disk geometry storage and faster ST_* bounding-box / area / length operations — overlay it on the spatial extension and most existing SQL keeps working.
